description: This file defines the ADODB2_sapdb class, a data dictionary implementation for SAP DB, including methods for type conversion, SQL generation for schema modifications, and handling of database-specific syntax.

classes.name: ADODB2_sapdb
classes.description: A class extending ADODB_DataDict to support SAP DB specific schema operations and data type mappings.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Converts internal metadata codes to SAP DB data types.

methods.name: MetaType
methods.description: Maps database field types to internal type codes used by ADODB.

methods.name: _CreateSuffix
methods.description: Generates SQL suffix for column definitions based on attributes like nullability, default, and unsigned.

methods.name: AddColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statement to add columns to a table.

methods.name: AlterColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statement to modify existing columns.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statement to drop columns from a table.
